name: pxc04
transitions: real->protected via the boot GDT @ 0x500 (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to flat code 0x08)

page tables: PT0 identity EXCEPT PT0[3]: linear 0x3000 -> phys 0x600000, starting NOT-PRESENT; PT1[0] 0x400000 -> phys 0x800000 (the new GDT), PT1[1] NP (demand-page target), PT1[2] 0x402000 -> phys 0x600000 (setup alias); CR3 + CR0.PG 0->1

case A (no partial commit): the 6-byte pseudo-descriptor at linear 0x2FFE (limit on page 2, base at 0x3000 on NP page 3) -> lgdt #PFs with CR2=0x3000 and GDTR UNCHANGED (the handler's SGDT shows base 0x500 -> marker 0x2038=0x600DF00D); the handler maps page 3 and IRETs; the lgdt restarts and completes

case B (correctness, non-contiguous frames): SGDT reads back base 0x400000 / limit 0x2F; the loaded GDTR is USED -- DS := 0x18 (data segment base 0x20F0 in the new GDT at phys 0x800000) and a read returns the sentinel 0xDEADBEEF, proving base AND limit landed from both physical frames (phys 0x3000 is poisoned 0x0B0B0B0B)
pfault flow: demand-page #PF at 0x401000 (restart + readback 0xCAFEBABE), #GP on selector 0x38 past the new GDT limit, #UD on UD2; counters accumulate to 4

witnesses.ecx at exit: 4 -- two #PF (crossing LGDT + demand-page) + one #GP + one #UD all delivered
witnesses.edx at exit: 0x004000F4 -- CR2 0x401000 captured by the demand-page #PF, low 16 bits clobbered by the 0xF4 exit-port load
witnesses.edi at exit: 0x600DF00D -- case A: GDTR was UNCHANGED by the rejected crossing read (in-handler GS:=0x18 + gs:0x20F0 read returns the sentinel only while GDTR still names the boot table; SGDT itself is decoder-scoped to !paging_on)
witnesses.ebx at exit: 0x600DF00D -- case B: the in-limit selector 0x28 (idx 5) committed through the new GDT (the #GP case on 0x38 brackets the limit from above)
witnesses.ebp at exit: 0xDEADBEEF -- case B: the sentinel read through the new GDT's 0x18 descriptor (the loaded GDTR actually works)

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-C03 regression for producer S_LGDT: the generic page-crossing fragment engine must complete a 6-byte GDTR pseudo-descriptor read straddling a page boundary with architecturally correct results. Differential against QEMU (helper_lgdt reads limit+base through the softmmu and commits env->gdt only after both succeed). Case A: with page 3 not-present the lgdt #PFs with CR2=0x3000 and GDTR is provably unchanged (no partial commit of the limit half). Case B: with page 3 on the non-adjacent phys frame 0x600000 the restarted lgdt's base+limit are read back via SGDT and the new GDT is exercised with a real segment load (sentinel read). Built on the pfault skeleton, whose #PF/#GP/#UD deliveries still run and count (the new GDT keeps a valid code32 at 0x08 so IDT deliveries work through the active table).
